# BUSINESS REQUIREMENT DOCUMENT (BRD)

## Change Request Title
AI Techpack Revision & BOM Version Update Management

## Purpose
Enable controlled processing of revised Techpacks received through AI automation while protecting existing Style, BOM, Costing, and Production data from unintended updates.

## Business Objective
• Prevent duplicate Style and BOM creation.
• Maintain integrity of processed BOM components.
• Support controlled revision of Style attributes.
• Manage addition of new Colors, Sizes, and Materials.
• Implement BOM version governance.
• Maintain complete audit history of AI-driven revisions.

## Current Challenges
• Duplicate Style/BOM creation.
• Unintended overwriting of BOM data.
• Loss of processed consumption and costing information.
• Lack of visibility into AI-driven changes.
• Insufficient BOM version controls.

## Scope
In Scope:
• Techpack Revision Processing
• Style Validation
• BOM Version Selection
• Controlled BOM Updates
• Color & Size Management
• Material Addition Handling
• Audit Logging

Out of Scope:
• Approved Production Order Changes
• Historical BOM Restructuring
• Costing Recalculation Logic

## Functional Requirements
FR-01: Do not create a new Style if the Style already exists.

FR-02: Allow user selection of target BOM version when multiple BOMs exist.

FR-03: Update only approved Style attributes from revised Techpack.

FR-04: Support controlled addition of new Colors and Sizes.

FR-05: Processed BOM lines shall not be overwritten.

FR-06: Consumption, Wastage, and Material Price shall remain unchanged if maintained within WFX.

FR-07: Existing Color/Size dependencies shall remain unchanged. New dependencies shall be marked RED until completed and GREEN after completion.

FR-08: New Materials shall be routed through Material Code Request workflow.

FR-09: CM values such as SAM and Efficiency shall remain unchanged.

FR-10: Restrict updates if BOM version status is Open or Waiting.

FR-11: Allow new BOM revision creation if existing BOM is Approved.

FR-12: Maintain AI processing audit logs.

FR-13: Maintain detailed change history logs.

## Business Rules
BR-01: Existing Styles shall not be duplicated.
BR-02: Processed BOM lines shall remain unchanged.
BR-03: Consumption, Wastage, and Price shall not be overwritten.
BR-04: New Materials must follow approval workflow.
BR-05: CM values shall remain protected.
BR-06: Open/Waiting BOM versions cannot be updated.
BR-07: Approved BOM versions may generate new revision versions.
BR-08: All AI-driven updates must be audit logged.

## Impacted Modules
• AI Techpack Processing
• Style Master
• BOM Management
• Material Management
• Costing
• CM Management
• Audit & Compliance

## UAT Scenarios
UAT-01: Verify no duplicate Style creation.
UAT-02: Verify BOM version selection.
UAT-03: Verify processed BOM lines remain unchanged.
UAT-04: Verify Consumption, Wastage, and Pricing remain protected.
UAT-05: Verify Color/Size dependency validation.
UAT-06: Verify Material Code Request workflow.
UAT-07: Verify BOM version status controls.
UAT-08: Verify audit trail and change history.

## Expected Benefits
• Improved control over AI-based Techpack revisions.
• Elimination of duplicate Style and BOM records.
• Protection of costing and production data.
• Improved traceability and compliance.
• Reduced manual effort.
• Better BOM version governance.
